title: Notification shows delta ??? with Native Mode when there are backfills
symptom: In G5 native mode, if readings are missed and then a new reading is obtained and the backfill is successful, the persistent notification still shows 'Delta: ???' when it should be able to recalculate the delta from the old values as is done in the main app activity.
